scope_honesty: Exercises REAL production components (GPU covariance, native C++ RiskEngine, OrderManager) + an ISOLATED in-memory mock broker. NOT economic validation; NO live orders. Native risk runs against a fresh per-test RuntimeState.
path: returns -> PortfolioAnalytics (GPU covariance) -> PortfolioOptimizer (native/CVXPY) -> CapitalReservationLedger -> CandidateRouter -> exposure gate -> native RiskEngine -> OrderManager -> SimulatedBroker -> fill reconciliation -> portfolio decision evidence
scenarios_covered: multiple simultaneous eligible strategies routed + filled through native risk
insufficient buying power -> native RiskEngine rejects
stale/unreconciled portfolio state -> fail-closed, no routing
advisory default (authorization NONE) -> routes nothing but emits evidence
GPU unavailable -> CPU covariance fallback still routes
unauthorized leveraged-inverse (SQQQ) blocked by exposure gate
duplicate run / restart -> reservation idempotent + pending guard prevents duplicate order
traceability: portfolio_decision_id links recommendation -> reservation -> ORDER_INTENT -> RISK_APPROVAL -> BROKER_ACK -> PARTIAL/COMPLETE_FILL via correlation_id.
verdict: MOCK-EXECUTION CERTIFIED through the existing financial authority. Economic/paper/live certification remain separate, gated milestones.
